azkar.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir
azkar.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is capable of all things.
All praise is due to Allah.
I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
azkar.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

azkar.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azkar.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
azkar.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
azkar.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.
